title: Device agent attestation (compact JWS), contract v1 (DRAFT v1-d4)
description: Sent by the page as device_attestation (contract-v1.md 6.4-6.8). Format [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-8/OQ-9; SRC: LD §16.18.5 L1397-1402]. Lifetime, single use, nonce and device binding [SRC: LD §16.18.5 L1381, L1387; PLAN §1.2 L51]. Checks a schema can't express (signature, kid in the enrolled device key registry, exp - iat <= 60 s, nonce unconsumed) are server checks, 6.7. Server-side also: alg pinned to ES256 before parsing; crit refused; aud and purpose must match the verifier; iat/exp skew ±30 s (G1); nonce consumed atomically before the result [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-35]; Addendum [TL Decision 2026-11-02, Addendum 12:15 PM PT].

device_id.description: Enrolled device id: a 1-128 char string, exact-match registry lookup; UUID recommended, not required [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-35, 8:12 PM reply]. Stand-in: starts standin- [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-33].

alg.description: Exactly ES256, pinned before parsing; none, HS*, RS* refused [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-35].

header.$comment: The key comes only from the enrolled device key registry by kid; embedded or remote key references and any crit header are refused [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-35]. Only alg, kid, typ allowed [TL Decision 2026-11-02, CR-03]; typ and aud required (8:12 PM reply).

nonce.description: The login service's transaction nonce, echoed [TL Decision 2026-11-02].

device_id.description: Must equal header kid [TL Decision 2026-11-02 (kid = device id)].

exp.description: exp - iat <= 60 [SRC: LD L1381]; ±30 s skew (G1) [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-35]; checked by the server.

aud.description: A single string: the login service issuer for purpose signin/handoff; the Cash Advance server for cage_action. The verifier rejects any other aud [TL Decision 2026-11-02, Addendum 12:15 PM PT (overrides OQ-35 'no aud')].

purpose.description: [TL Decision 2026-11-02, Addendum]. Verifier rejects a wrong purpose.

claims.$comment: additionalProperties false: the five TL-listed claims plus aud and purpose (Addendum). No jti: single use comes from the nonce [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-35]. The aud value vs purpose pairing depends on deployment issuer URLs, so it is a server check (6.7), not a schema check.
